capabilities.name: Create document
capabilities.description: Create document
capabilities.source: Pl Docs / File and Document Management
capabilities.notes: Current beta capability must be verified against the implementation before being marked complete.

capabilities.name: Open document
capabilities.description: Open an existing PL Docs document from project storage.
capabilities.source: PL Docs / File and Document Management
capabilities.notes: Validated for existing Markdown documents.

capabilities.name: Save document
capabilities.description: Persist document content to project storage.
capabilities.source: PL Docs / File and Document Management
capabilities.notes: Current backend writes through a temporary file before rename.

capabilities.name: Close document
capabilities.description: Close the active document without terminating the project.
capabilities.source: PL Docs / File and Document Management
capabilities.notes: Current Docs v0 validation confirms document close behavior.

capabilities.name: Save document as
capabilities.description: Save the current document as a new document or filename.
capabilities.source: PL Docs / File and Document Management

capabilities.name: Rename document
capabilities.description: Rename a document while preserving its contents and project references.
capabilities.source: PL Docs / File and Document Management
capabilities.notes: Explicitly listed as a Docs v0 limitation.

capabilities.name: Delete and restore document
capabilities.description: Delete a project document and support safe restoration.
capabilities.source: PL Docs / File and Document Management
capabilities.notes: Delete is explicitly listed as a Docs v0 limitation.

capabilities.name: Autosave and crash recovery
capabilities.description: Automatically preserve document work and recover it after interruption or crash.
capabilities.source: PL Docs / Recovery and Version History
capabilities.notes: Manual save is reliable, but full autosave and recovery behavior still needs the shared v1.2 history/recovery foundation.

capabilities.name: Markdown source editing
capabilities.description: Edit Markdown document source directly.
capabilities.notes: Current Docs v0 provides a functional Markdown editor and preview.

capabilities.name: Rich-text editor
capabilities.description: Provide polished structured rich-text editing.
capabilities.notes: Rich-text editing is explicitly listed as missing from Docs v0.

capabilities.name: Structured document model
capabilities.description: Represent text, formatting, metadata, assets, comments, links, headings, revisions, and project references in a structured internal document model.
capabilities.notes: Current storage is Markdown-oriented rather than the complete official-v1 structured document model.

capabilities.name: Undo and redo
capabilities.description: Provide reliable document-level undo and redo.
capabilities.notes: Beta target includes undo/redo, but full structured-editor history will require later validation.

capabilities.name: Find and replace
capabilities.description: Search document content and replace selected or matching text.
capabilities.notes: Listed in the Beta/dev-v1 target but requires implementation audit before complete status.

capabilities.name: Outline and bookmark navigation
capabilities.description: Navigate documents through headings, outline structure, and bookmarks.

capabilities.name: Page-oriented layout
capabilities.description: Display and edit documents using page boundaries and physical page layout.

capabilities.name: Character and paragraph formatting
capabilities.description: Support core character, paragraph, alignment, spacing, indentation, and text formatting.
capabilities.notes: Beta specification includes basic formatting, headings and lists, while official-v1 requires complete core formatting.

capabilities.name: Document styles and themes
capabilities.description: Support reusable paragraph styles, document styles, and themes.

capabilities.name: Page settings
capabilities.description: Support page size, margins, orientation, columns, and breaks.

capabilities.name: Headers footers and page numbering
capabilities.description: Provide headers, footers, and document page numbering.

capabilities.name: Tables
capabilities.description: Insert, edit, format, resize, and manage document tables.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.3.3 — Tables, images, shapes, and objects
capabilities.notes: Simple tables are part of the Beta target; richer table behavior remains an official-v1 requirement.

capabilities.name: Images
capabilities.description: Insert, crop, resize, rotate, wrap, caption, compress, replace, and provide alt text for images.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.3.3 — Tables, images, shapes, and objects
capabilities.notes: Basic image support is a Beta requirement; the complete official-v1 object workflow is not yet implemented.

capabilities.name: Shapes and text boxes
capabilities.description: Create and manipulate shapes, text boxes, connectors, grouping, layering, alignment, and wrapping.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.3.3 — Tables, images, shapes, and objects

capabilities.name: Hyperlinks and internal links
capabilities.description: Create external hyperlinks and internal document links.
capabilities.notes: Basic links are part of the Beta target; full internal-link and reference behavior remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Citations bibliography and source manager
capabilities.description: Create citations, manage research sources, and generate bibliographies.

capabilities.name: Footnotes endnotes and cross-references
capabilities.description: Support footnotes, endnotes, cross-references, and document reference targets.

capabilities.name: Generated document indexes
capabilities.description: Generate a table of contents and lists of figures or tables.

capabilities.name: Spell checking and language tools
capabilities.description: Provide spell checking, custom dictionary, language settings, and readability tools.

capabilities.name: Comments and discussion
capabilities.description: Create comments, replies, resolve comments, and reopen resolved discussions.

capabilities.name: Tracked changes and suggestions
capabilities.description: Track edits and support suggestion, accept, reject, and comparison workflows.

capabilities.name: Document templates
capabilities.description: Provide built-in and user templates with variables and metadata placeholders.

capabilities.name: Common document import
capabilities.description: Import TXT, MD, HTML, DOCX, and RTF documents.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.3.6 — Interchange, printing, AI, and cross-slice
capabilities.notes: Native Markdown open/read is implemented; broader common-format import is not.

capabilities.name: Common document export
capabilities.description: Export TXT, MD, HTML, DOCX, PDF, and print-ready document output.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.3.6 — Interchange, printing, AI, and cross-slice
capabilities.notes: Beta target includes TXT and Markdown export; full official-v1 interchange remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Professional printing and PDF
capabilities.description: Produce professional print layouts and PDF output.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.3.6 — Interchange, printing, AI, and cross-slice

capabilities.name: Live project asset links
capabilities.description: Reference project assets and preserve live links between Docs content and project data.

capabilities.name: Cross-slice workflows
capabilities.description: Integrate Docs workflows with Code, Spreadsheets, Modeling, Animation, and Game Studio.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.3.6 — Interchange, printing, AI, and cross-slice
capabilities.notes: Includes linked code, spreadsheet data, models, production assets, and game-development documentation workflows.

capabilities.name: Project-aware AI proposals
capabilities.description: Provide project-aware AI assistance through explicit proposed changes rather than silent document modification.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.3.6 — Interchange, printing, AI, and cross-slice
capabilities.notes: AI edits must remain user-controlled and proposal-based.

capabilities.name: Optional collaboration
capabilities.description: Support optional collaborative document workflows without making cloud connectivity mandatory.
capabilities.source: PL Docs / Dev v2 Official v1 Target
capabilities.notes: Collaboration is optional; local-first document operation remains required.

capabilities.name: Document version history
capabilities.description: Maintain recoverable local document history across edits and restarts.
capabilities.source: PL Docs / Recovery and Version History
